scope: Actual Force abstract loop, avoidSamePosition, Eades and Fruchterman-Reingold math; no Stress model acceptance
facts: Verified all four proposed raw spans plus vector support SHA/base64 against fixed elkjs worker bytes. Added closing brace70337 as support only.

Initialize adjacency before seeded random positions; interactive preserves centers. Noninteractive two nextDouble draws/node. REPULSIVE_POWER positive creates edge-local and graph-wide bendpoints in source order, distributing after each edge allocation.

Each iteration refreshes labels then distributes bends; FR lowers temperature at this point before displacement. Particle encounter nodes, labels, bendpoints, outer forcee then inner forcer. Accumulate all displacement before bound/apply/reset, except avoidSamePosition explicitly mutates live positions during pair calculation.

Bound uses ordered per-axis comparisons, not max/min that can swallow NaN. Vector lengths/distances use source sqrt(x*x+y*y), not hypot. Preserve nonfinite intermediate IEEE outcomes and final shared JSON wire mapping.

AvoidSamePosition resets triedForBendPoints inside each while; the bendpoint case constructs two fresh vectors, compares their identity, and adds BOTH to pu. Do not fix second-add target or invent termination cap. Non-bendpoint case draws four nextDouble-equivalent draws in exact order; uses existing approved JavaRandom.

Eades distance subtracts each full size diagonal/2 then max(0); connections use weighted graph adjacency. Positive connection uses only attraction, absent/nonpositive connection only repulsion*forcer priority. Source d<=0 constants/log/division behavior retained.

FR computes both repulsion and positive-connection attraction; applies temperature/length scale. k uses sequential width/height sums, area/(2*n), spacing*.01. No alternate area formula, fsum or integer-rounding.

Eades terminates count<iterations. FR threshold=temperature/iterations and terminates solely temperature>0; preserve floating subtraction extra-iteration/zero/negative values rather than replacing with integer for range. Cancellation checked at while condition and monitor done once.
limitations: Runtime integration, generic metadata, public parser, full Force/Stress comparison and release remain separate.
Preserve internal NaN/Infinity and original source exceptions; existing native finite input admission is not expanded by source acceptance.
